pages.text: Every morning, they set a little table in the boat's middle. Today, noodles! Bung and Ddori sat facing each other.
Ducks passed outside, quacking. Bung stretched to look. "Finish eating, Ddori, then let us see the ducks."
Ddori held a spoon in both hands. Bung took it. "I will feed you."
Bung pushed a spoonful toward Ddori's mouth. Ddori pressed the mouth shut.
Another spoonful. Ddori shook the head this way and that.
Ddori pushed the bowl hard. Broth spilled across the table.
Bung wiped it up with a cloth. The duck calls grew farther away.
Mom set down a fresh bowl. "That spoon is Ddori's."
Bung put the spoon in Ddori's hand. Ddori ate, dropping bits of noodles.
Only two empty bowls remained. Bung and Ddori sat at the bow. Ducks passed in a line again.
